paragraphs.source_en: To this, I said nothing, but taking the one-and-a-half sen lying on his desk, I put it back into my purse. Then Porcupine asked me wonderingly if I was really going to put it back into my purse. "Yes," I replied, "at first I did not like the idea of being treated by you and wished to pay, but later consideration has made me think otherwise. I have taken it back as I thought I had better be treated by you." At this, he laughed outright with his usual, loud ha! ha! and asked me why I had not taken it much sooner. I answered I had wished to do so often, but the bashfulness I felt compelled me to let it lie; that of late it made me feel quite ill at ease to come to school and see the coppers.
